interface.signature: def maxScoreWords(words: list[str], letters: list[str], score: list[int]) -> int:

preconditions.description: The number of words is between 1 and 14 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(w) <= 15 for w in words)
preconditions.description: Each word has a length between 1 and 15 inclusive.
The number of available letters is between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(l) == 1 and 'a' <= l <= 'z' for l in letters)
preconditions.description: Each item in letters is a single lowercase English letter.

preconditions.expression: len(score) == 26 and all(0 <= s <= 10 for s in score)
preconditions.description: The score list has exactly 26 integers, each between 0 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all('a' <= c <= 'z' for c in w) for w in words)
preconditions.description: All words contain only lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: return_value == max((sum(score[ord(c) - ord('a')] for c in w) for w in subset) for subset in valid_subsets)
postconditions.description: The return value is the maximum total score achievable by any subset of words that can be formed using the given letters, where each letter is used at most as many times as it appears in the input letters list.
